# Design & Frontend Skills (taste-skill)
Installed globally from https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill (`~/.claude/skills/`).
For any frontend, UI, or visual work, invoke the matching skill with the `Skill` tool instead of designing from defaults.

**Implementation skills (output code):**
| When | Skill |
| --- | --- |
| Default for landing pages, portfolios, marketing sites | `design-taste-frontend` (v2) |
| Need exact v1 behavior for backward compat | `design-taste-frontend-v1` |
| GPT/Codex-style stricter variant, heavy GSAP motion | `gpt-taste` |
| Generate design images first, then build to match | `image-to-code` |
| Improving an existing site/app without breaking it | `redesign-existing-projects` |
| Polished, calm, expensive feel (soft contrast, spring motion) | `high-end-visual-design` |
| Editorial product UI (Notion/Linear vibes) | `minimalist-ui` |
| Hard mechanical Swiss/terminal aesthetic, data-heavy dashboards | `industrial-brutalist-ui` |
| Model is truncating or shipping placeholder code | `full-output-enforcement` |
| Authoring a DESIGN.md for Google Stitch | `stitch-design-taste` |

**Image-generation skills (output reference images only, no code):**
| When | Skill |
| --- | --- |
| Website/landing page design references | `imagegen-frontend-web` |
| Mobile app screen concepts and flows | `imagegen-frontend-mobile` |
| Brand guideline boards, logo systems, identity decks | `brandkit` |

Update these with: `npx skills update -g`
